pr_title: Add unique id to DHCP step in Config Flow for Overkiz

<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

The Overkiz integration uses default core [DHCP discovery](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/dhcp/), thus I would think that this is supported by default. We need to investigate what is required to add an Ignore button.

@chemelli74 / other maintainers, this issue is related to the new Overkiz integration in dev branch (domain: `overkiz`) and is currently labeled wrongly.

> The Overkiz integration uses default core DHCP discovery, thus I would think that this is supported by default. 

That is incorrect. 

- This integration does not implement default discovery, it implements its own logic for handling DHCP discovery in its config flow (it implements the `dhcp` step).
- You need to implement a unique ID in the configuration flow in order to support that. Please note, it is required for integration to provide the ignore ability.
We will work on it, thanks for the pointers. This should be an easy fix.
